scenes.name: 01_天气屋与森林全景
scenes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished original landscape environment concept painting for the same small third-person game, 天气屋 / Weather House. Wide 16:9 landscape composition, one scene filling the whole canvas, not a collage or contact sheet.
The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Closely follow its visual language: softly lit stylized 3D game environment translated into painterly concept art, clear sculpted angular stone planes, muted yellow-green grass, cool blue-gray shadows, pale cyan sky, monumental soft white cloud shapes, subtle hand-painted color variation, flowers in restrained white/yellow/blue clusters, atmospheric depth. Delicate brushwork with readable volumes and believable terrain. Match the reference's clean large shapes and controlled detail density. Avoid photorealism, glossy plastic, heavy impasto, black outlines, oversaturated candy colors, dramatic epic fantasy, giant magical portals, UI, text, labels, watermark, borders.
This is a cozy healing forest game about a young apprentice witch helping small animals by understanding pictographic animal language and gently adjusting local weather. Natural animal homes with a few tiny handmade domestic objects. The setting must feel like a playable human-scale place with legible paths and uncluttered interaction areas, not a miniature toy diorama. Trees enclose the edges while generous clearings reveal the sky.
Consistent protagonist when present: a small 3.5-to-4-head-tall storybook girl, short chestnut bob hair, soft muted blue-green floppy witch hat with a modest brim, simple cream tunic under a short muted teal cape, brown ankle boots, carrying a short naturally curved wooden wand. Cute but not exaggerated baby proportions; small in the environment, never a portrait. Animals have rounded, appealing storybook proportions and natural fur/skin, not clothes.
Recurring weather cottage when visible: a modest single-storey cream-plaster and warm timber house with a steep moss-green shingle roof, small stone chimney, one round window, wooden porch, and simple weather vane; rustic and lovingly lived-in, not ornate.
Scene: ESTABLISHING KEY ART of the whole small neighborhood at the edge of a forest. Slightly elevated but grounded third-person scenic viewpoint from a grassy rise, clear three-quarter view of the cottage as the main focal point. Show a coherent compact playable layout: cottage and garden clearing in the near-middle ground, a large old oak with a tiny squirrel tree hollow and drying rack along the curving footpath, a glimpse of a blue-green pond lower down the path, and a low flower-covered hill beyond. These destinations must be nearby and connected by one readable winding path, with clusters of faceted mossy rocks and rounded trees separating views. No distant sprawling world or town. The little witch walks away from the cottage with her wand; one small squirrel waits by the path.
Weather and light: luminous cool overcast after prolonged gentle rain, wet stone steps and small reflective puddles, a localized soft shaft of warm sunlight through a modest cloud opening revealing the destination. Large white-gray cloud shapes and pale sky fill approximately the upper third. Still inviting and colorful, no gloomy storm. Clear hierarchy of landmark house, old oak, pond, hill, with quiet open spaces. This image should help a game artist decide the primary scenery assets and how the areas connect.

Scene: an intimate playable FOREST COURTYARD centered on the first weather puzzle. Eye-level wide three-quarter composition. A large old oak trunk with a small natural squirrel hollow and modest twig landing sits to one side. Nearby is a simple human-knee-height twig drying rack holding a few broad damp leaves used as bedding. Just a few steps across the same clearing is a little bright-green moss bed sheltered between rounded faceted rocks, with a large leaf umbrella deliberately leaned aside. A round cute squirrel tends the drying rack; a friendly small frog sits beside the moss bed, clearly readable but secondary to the environment.
The little witch is seen from behind and three-quarter view in the foreground with her wooden wand raised. She is gently moving ONE small soft low rain cloud over the frog's moss bed. The small cloud floats around lower-tree-canopy height, physically in the scene. It rains only on the moss bed; the drying rack and squirrel now receive a warm patch of sunshine. Both weather conditions must be visible simultaneously and spatially coherent. Rain falls as fine sparse silver streaks, with tiny ripples and wet surfaces, no torrential sheet. The little cloud is a soft gray sculptural volume without a face, not a cartoon icon.
Keep a clear traversable strip of ground between the girl, rack and frog. A faint cottage roof through the trees provides continuity. Include white wildflowers, restrained blue flowers, a fallen log seat, damp earth and an old small wooden picture plaque beside the rack showing a simple sunshine pictogram, no writing. Emphasize the beautiful boundary between cool damp shade and a warm sunlit patch, subtle magic as a few leaves and thin pale airflow accents. This is environment concept art, not a diagram or tutorial screenshot.

Scene: a quiet POND CLEARING in the same neighborhood. Wide composition from a low bank, with the pond taking roughly the middle half of the image and a clear walkable grassy shoreline curving around it. Shallow transparent turquoise-green water with a visible sandy-stony bed near the camera, soft depth color further out, restrained painted reflections of clouds and trees. Two rounded stylized orange-and-cream koi are visibly swimming just beneath the near surface, readable through the water, with small coherent ripple rings. A small blue songbird perches on a weathered branch above the bank, and a cute young deer stands quietly on the far grassy shore. No human architecture under water.
The same little witch crouches or kneels at the near bank, wooden wand held loosely, watching the fish. Her silhouette must read clearly without dominating. Main assets: gently faceted mossy boulders, a fallen log beside the water as a place to sit, a few stepping stones at a narrow shallow edge, grouped ferns, water-edge grasses, a few water lilies and small white flowers. Keep the middle shore open for movement and observation; avoid overcrowding it with plants. A partially visible modest timber weather-chime post integrated among the rocks, a provisional natural handcrafted design.
Lighting: fresh calm moment after gentle rain, soft sunlight across part of the pond, cool shaded foreground, cloud reflections opening above. A very small localized drizzle touches the far side of the water, contrasting with the clearer near shore. The weather cottage roof is only a tiny recognizable glimpse through distant trees. Emphasize painterly water, fish visibility, ripples, shore vegetation, and intimacy in a playable space. No waterfall, no giant lake, no monumental temple, no bridge clutter.

Scene: a breezy FLOWER-COVERED LOW HILL, the third nearby destination in Weather House. Wide landscape composition from behind the little witch standing beside a simple rustic weather-chime post made of a forked branch, wooden pieces, and a few pale hanging ribbons. This small handcrafted device is the focal interaction object; it is modest, readable and buildable, not a large machine. A rounded young deer stands nearby, relaxed; one tiny blue bird circles just above the grass.
A gentle gust travels visibly across the slope through directional bands of bending grass, fern fronds, leaves and hanging ribbons. The witch raises her short wooden wand to guide the breeze; restrained fine pale wind streaks echo the reference. There are no huge glowing beams, no combat, no tornado. Clusters of sculpted blue-gray rocks, low shrubs, white and yellow wildflowers, blue flowers in the shaded foreground; open footpath ascending through the hill.
In the middle-distance below, clearly glimpse the SAME cream-and-timber weather cottage with moss-green roof, the old oak and a little reflective pond as nearby landmarks connected by a curving path. Keep the world compact and cozy. Give a generous upper half to pale cyan sky and large soft white clouds parting into warm late-afternoon light. Fresh cool greens in shade, warm muted yellow-green on the ridge, natural atmospheric depth. The composition should communicate looking back at places the player has helped, and show wind-driven foliage and sky as the visual rewards. Match the attached reference's shape design and painterly restrained colors.
